prompt: Infographic poster titled "How a Loaf of Sourdough Becomes a Loaf". High-end editorial information design, modular card layout with flowing arrows, data chips, tiny spot illustrations, and a cross-section loaf hero in the center. Color scheme: toasted crust brown, flour cream, rye charcoal, a single mustard accent. Must include: 01 Starter (ratio 1:1:1 flour-water-culture, 24h cycle), 02 Autolyse (rest 45 min, hydration 78%), 03 Bulk Fermentation (4 stretch-and-folds, 5h at 24°C), 04 Shaping (tension, seam-down basket), 05 Cold Proof (12–16h at 4°C), 06 Bake (covered Dutch oven 230°C, uncovered 20 min), and a flavor spectrum (tangy / nutty / sweet / earthy). Must read like a premium bakery wall chart, not a textbook diagram
riskNote: 第三方图文案例仅用于学习拆解；发布或商用前回到原页面确认授权。
publishAngle: 适合沉淀为 Image2 能力边界与复刻提示词样例。
